weeks.title: Syllabus and Chapter 2 Introduction
weeks.coverage: Syllabus first, then an introduction using the opening student-table examples. The instructor indicates where to stop and resume; finishing the Week 1 reading section during the first meeting is not required.

weeks.title: Keys and Relational Algebra
weeks.coverage: Continue unfinished introductory examples as needed, then superkeys, candidate/primary/composite/foreign keys, schema diagrams, selection, projection, product, join, and set operations; four-table database demonstration.

weeks.title: Basic SQL
weeks.coverage: DDL basics; SELECT, FROM, WHERE, aliases, expressions, duplicates, patterns, ordering, and set operations.

weeks.title: NULL, Aggregation, and Selected Subqueries
weeks.coverage: Three-valued logic, aggregation, GROUP BY, HAVING, selected subqueries, CTEs, and reversible modifications.

weeks.title: Intermediate SQL
weeks.coverage: Explicit and outer joins, ON and WHERE, views, constraints, reference actions, and basic transactions.

weeks.title: Written Exam 1
weeks.coverage: Written Exam 1 on the selected classroom material from Chapters 2-4.

weeks.title: Selected Advanced SQL
weeks.coverage: Ranking and window functions, recursive CTEs, one audit trigger, and stored-routine purpose and interface.

weeks.title: E-R Design Foundations
weeks.coverage: Requirements, entities, attributes, relationships, roles, cardinality, participation, keys, and weak entities.

weeks.title: Asynchronous Review
weeks.coverage: No class, examination, or new material; asynchronous review while the instructor attends INFORMS.

weeks.title: E-R Design and Relational Mapping
weeks.coverage: Redundancy, design choices, E-R-to-relational mapping, keys, foreign keys, and mapped-schema verification.

weeks.title: Normalization
weeks.coverage: Anomalies, functional dependencies, closure, lossless decomposition, spurious tuples, and introductory 3NF and BCNF.

weeks.title: Written Exam 2
weeks.coverage: Written Exam 2 on the selected classroom material from Chapters 5-7.

weeks.title: Indexing
weeks.coverage: Index purpose, B+ tree access, composite-column order, covering indexes, and query-plan evidence.

weeks.title: Query Processing and Optimization
weeks.coverage: Scans and searches, join access order, equivalence checks, selectivity, statistics, ANALYZE, and plan interpretation.

weeks.title: Transactions
weeks.coverage: Transaction boundaries, ACID, states, schedules, conflicts, precedence graphs, recoverability, and isolation phenomena.

weeks.title: Concurrency Control, Recovery, and Review
weeks.coverage: S/X locks, grant and wait, deadlock, log records, WAL, simplified redo and undo, and integrated review.

weeks.title: University Anniversary Make-Up Holiday
weeks.coverage: No class, examination, assignment, or new material.

weeks.title: Written Exam 3
weeks.coverage: Written Exam 3 on selected Chapters 14-19 and cumulative application of taught SQL and database-design concepts.
